sections.content:
RockX is a digital asset services platform that aims to unlock the full value of digital assets and decentralised governance mechanisms for token holders and those seeking to enter the digital asset market. By providing sophisticated services for cryptocurrency markets, RockX will drive the mass adoption of digital assets while accelerating public blockchains' development and ecosystems. Initially launching with a secure Staking-as-a-Service platform, RockX plans to roll out additional services and products to serve as a trusted one-stop platform for all market participants.
It was founded by entrepreneurs with diverse economics, finance, and technology background and years of experience in the blockchain ecosystem. The company is looking for a highly motivated blockchain engineer to participate in the project to build a world-class blockchain staking platform.

sections.heading: Duties & Responsibilities
sections.content:
Design and implement secure, user-friendly UI and integrate with various applications
Contribute tools and libraries for open-source projects
Document the design, implementation, and testing of the system developed
Work closely with other engineers to deliver quality products.

sections.heading: Qualifications
sections.content:
Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or other relevant disciplines
At least one year experience as a frontend developer.
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, Javascript / Typescript
Experience in web development frameworks, such as React/Angular/Vue.js
Good Experience with UI testing frameworks such as Selenium, Jasmine and Jest
Experience developing modular UI components
Experience with webpack and/or babel for bundling or transpiling
Experience with REST and websocket APIs, interacting with server side components
Knowledge of Reactive Programming (Rxjs etc)
Interest in blockchain / web3 technology and quick learner
Knowledge of cryptography and blockchain protocols, such as Web3 will be a plus
Can-do mindset, critical thinking and pursuit of engineering excellence
Being both a great individual programmer and a great team player.
We provide competitive salaries and benefits, a flexible, creative, and agile working environment, and exposure to the latest technologies. The role is a full-time remote position.
